title: Director, Warehouse Operations
text:
Role Overview:

The Director, Warehouse Operations is accountable for effectively managing US warehousing operations to include receiving, shipping, transfers, inventory control, labor management, and safeguarding Brother assets. The position is accountable for the Warehouse Operations budget to control costs and to reduce expenditures without compromising the operation’s capabilities to service customers. The Director, Warehouse Operations is accountable for the development and implementation of continuous improvement initiatives that will enable operational efficiencies across all warehouses to improve customer satisfaction and savings. This position creates an environment of collaboration and respect among the various departments such as Finance, Information Technology (IT) and Transportation to drive overall supply chain excellence throughout the delivery process.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Operations Management

* + Oversee daily warehouse operations within the Brother distribution network (East Coast, West Coast, Tennessee, etc.)
 + Drive improvement through collaboration and analysis; support manufacturing, channel partners, and end-users
 + Monitor all warehousing operations in designated external warehouses while utilizing best practices
 + Ensure shipment compliance including the quality, timing and accurate delivery of products
 + Drive performance results through the management of the third partly logistics provider
 + Provide direction, leadership and guidance to leadership staff and monitor the efficiency, knowledge and skill sets of the staff and provide the necessary guidance, training, coaching, feedback and appraisal as necessary
 + Create an environment of collaboration, innovation, problem-solving and continuous improvement
 + Foster inventory strategies that deliver improvements in productivity, quality, and cost
 + Identify the best way to ensure correct inventory management by creating a robust repeatable process including the latest technology
 + Develop, direct, and manage overall improvement targets and oversee execution of initiatives
 + Work closely with the Supply Chain Planning team to guarantee “hot items” are available at the Warehouse to satisfy customer demand
 + Work closely with the Inbound / Outbound Transportation teams to guarantee “hot containers” and/or “hot orders” are managed by aligned Customer Service Levels Agreements

Strategic Direction

* + Develop an overall plan from the current state to the future state that meets business and customer requirements for best-in-class service for inventory, warehousing operations and delivery
 + Assess current and future operational risks locally, and translate those into strategies, capabilities, best practices, and key performance indicators (KPIs)
 + Develop and deploy inventory and operations performance standards that support and align with company strategy and customer expectations across the distribution network
 + Develop a continuous improvement approach across the warehouse operations organization to challenge the operational “status quo” and optimize operational cost and service
 + Partner with the HR, IT, Procurement and Financial teams to address open issues and develop best-in-class cross functional practices, processes, metrics, and reports for the warehouse operations area
 + Work closely with the Supply Chain Planning team to plan for future warehouse space for efficient utilization to minimize expenses
 + Work closely with the Inbound / Outbound Transportation teams to develop joint plans to improve customer service levels and operational costs
 + Work closely with the order management team to define “Total Order Cycle” optimization initiatives to improve customer satisfaction and operational costs

Provider and Vendor Management

* + Conduct monthly and quarterly business reviews (MBR & QBR) with all 3rd party providers to ensure consistent Service Levels are met and business and customer needs are addressed
 + Partner with the procurement organization to manage vendor relationships and pricing agreements for warehousing services
 + Ensure business and customer service commitments are being upheld and address deficiencies accordingly
 + Develop a continuous improvement approach with all 3rd party providers to maximize customer service levels and optimize operational costs
 + Manage leasing of available space and ensure warehouse facilities are maintained to support shipping and Customer Service

Management of Departmental Financial Responsibilities

* + Create the annual divisional budget
 + Partner with Finance to perform Monthly budget analysis for all Warehouse Operational costs and develop bridge plans to stay within the budget requirements while still maintaining the required Business and Customer service levels
 + Continually identify opportunities for improvement, quality, cost and service
 + Develop Monthly Warehouse Operations Risk & Opportunities based on operational efficiencies/inefficiencies
 + Partner with the Finance team to identify and track the financial impacts of continuous improvement initiatives
 + Ensure that all warehouse operations financial functions are accurate, and timely and meet all established JSOX and financial policies
 + Track, analyze, and report warehouse and 3PL labor costs and develop corrective actions if not achieving targets

Experience & Qualifications:

Education Level

* + Bachelor's Degree (or equivalent experience) in Business, Supply Chain, Logistics or related field- Required
 + Master's Degree (or equivalent experience) Business, Supply Chain, Logistics or related field- preferred

Experience Level

* + Minimum 12 years 
 - Managing a high-volume distribution center including extensive inventory control experience.Managing onsite 3PL vendor relationships and performance metrics.
 + Minimum 10 years 
 - Leading national warehouse operations
 + Minimum 7 years 
 - Continuous Improvement and operational transformation achievements

Software/Technical Skills

* + Warehouse Management System (WMS)
 + Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel and PowerPoint)
 + SAP Order Management

Other Skills/Knowledge/Abilities

* + Strong attention to quality and detail
 + Ability to impact change through influence and collaboration across multiple levels of the organization
 + Ability to successfully manage through complexity
 + Demonstrated leadership and management skills; the ability to motivate positive and cooperative working relationships
 + Knowledge of accounting principles and practices
 + Demonstrated ability to articulate a vision, translating it into executable strategy and driving cross-functional teams to deliver against a plan
 + Advanced continuous improvement skills and operational application
 + Project management and large project oversight experience

 
Additional Details for This Role:

This role will be an onsite role. You are expected to work from the stated job location 5 days a week. #LI-Onsite

Base Salary

* + The targeted base salary range for this position is **$ 165,000.00- $ 185,000.00** per year.
 + Base salary is determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the successful candidate, as well as factors such as internal equity, cost of labor in the hiring location, and alignment with market data.

Additional Compensation

* + This position is eligible for a **30%** bonus at 100% of target, with the opportunity to achieve above 100% dependent on company performance and in alignment with company bonus plans.
 + Bonus awards are discretionary and contingent upon individual performance as well as Brother achieving its corporate objectives, in accordance with the applicable bonus plan in effect.
